original_question: Given a proportionally modular numerical semigroup by its minimal generators, find formulas for its Frobenius number, genus, and type directly from that minimal generating system.
target_in_paper: Section 2, the open problem asking for formulas for the Frobenius number, genus, and type of a proportionally modular numerical semigroup in terms of its minimal generating system. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
correct_elements: Your draft already identifies the right family of semigroups, the right three invariants, and the right input format: it asks about proportionally modular numerical semigroups and seeks formulas for Frobenius number, genus, and type from the minimal generators. That matches the Section 2 problem, and it is narrower than the neighboring Section 3 quotient problem. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
missing_details: State the ambient object explicitly: S is a numerical semigroup, i.e. a submonoid S⊂ℕ under addition with finite complement in ℕ. No ring/field, homogeneity, degree, or nilpotency assumptions are relevant here. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))

Specify the input as the unique minimal system of generators S=⟨n1,…,ne⟩ with 0<n1<⋯<ne. The paper speaks of the semigroup 'in terms of its system of minimal generators,' not just an arbitrary generating set. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))

Make explicit that S is assumed to be proportionally modular, meaning that S is the set of solutions in ℕ of an inequality ax mod b ≤ cx for some positive integers a,b,c; the paper notes one may take c<a<b. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
Define the invariants: F(S)=max(ℕ\S), g(S)=|ℕ\S|, PF(S)={x∈ℤ\S : x+s∈S for every s∈S\{0}}, and t(S)=|PF(S)|. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))

Add the universal quantifier: the question is asking for formulas valid for every proportionally modular numerical semigroup, not only for modular semigroups, open modular semigroups, or some small embedding-dimension subclass. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))

Clarify that the desired formulas should depend only on the minimal generating system itself, not on a chosen defining proportionally modular inequality, interval description, or Bézout-sequence presentation. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))

To remain paper-faithful, do not broaden the target to the nearby Section 3 problem about semigroups of the form ⟨a,a+1⟩/d, which additionally asks for other invariants such as multiplicity and embedding dimension. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
refined_question: Let S=⟨n1,…,ne⟩⊂ℕ be a numerical semigroup with unique minimal generating system 0<n1<⋯<ne, and assume that S is proportionally modular, i.e. S={x∈ℕ : ax mod b ≤ cx} for some positive integers a,b,c (equivalently, one may take c<a<b). Write F(S)=max(ℕ\S), g(S)=|ℕ\S|, and t(S)=|PF(S)|, where PF(S)={x∈ℤ\S : x+s∈S for every s∈S\{0}}. Find explicit formulas for F(S), g(S), and t(S) that depend only on the minimal generating system n1,…,ne. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
justification: The draft is already very close to the paper’s intended problem: Section 2 ends by singling out exactly the task of obtaining formulas for Frobenius number, genus, and type of a proportionally modular numerical semigroup from its minimal generators. Section 1 supplies the definitions of those invariants, while the preceding discussion in Section 2 explains why a formulation 'in terms of the minimal generators' is natural. Section 3 gives an equivalent class-level description of proportionally modular semigroups as quotients of embedding-dimension-two semigroups (and even as semigroups of the form ⟨a,a+1⟩/d), but the question posed there is broader; since your draft does not ask about multiplicity or embedding dimension, the narrow Section 2 formulation is the nearest faithful target. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1304.6552))
